data.name: North Dallas Shutters & Blinds Dallas, TX

reviews.text: This has been the easiest fastest home improvement project we have ever done! My husband and I went out on a Saturday looking for plantation shutter showrooms. We went to the address for North Dallas Shutters and Blinds that I found on Google and could not find them. I called the phone number but did not leave a voicemail. Later that evening I received a call (and text) from Daniel saying that he saw he had missed my call! I was shocked. I texted him back explaining I was looking for his showroo

INCREDIBLE experience! Daniel did an amazing job explaining to me the different types of coverings and shades.  He was very patient in helping me figure out what would work best for my needs.  Very fair prices and the service and install was perfect. Now that our bedroom is taken care of (yay, sleep! 🤣)  we will definitely be using North Dallas Shutters & Blinds soon for our living room (I hate tv sun-glare). I would 100% recommend NDSB to EVERYONE!

NDSB did an awesome job installing custom shades in my home! They were super friendly, showed up on time, and helped me pick the perfect shades. The quality is top-notch, and they fit like a glove. The whole process was quick, clean, and hassle-free. Totally love the new vibe in my house—would definitely recommend them!
